_comment: Hand-placed hazard anchors for make_overlays.py. Footprints are APPROXIMATE (illustrative, not official). Hazard model: water depth (ft) at a point = peak * (1 - d/half_width) within half_width miles of a river line; pools: peak * (1 - 0.6 d/radius). 'present' = share of the peak physically present at each step (forecast steps show the predicted peak). Same model as demo/model.js.
name: Hurricane Harvey

narrative.0: Impact: Buffalo, Brays and White Oak bayous out of their banks. Substations flooding.
narrative.12: Peak flooding. Reservoir releases flood the Energy Corridor.
narrative.48: Water receding slowly. Power restoration begins in dry areas.
narrative.168: Recovery: most water gone. Demand surge for contractors and materials.
narrative.-48: Forecast: Harvey expected to stall over Houston. NWS warns of catastrophic, life-threatening rainfall.
narrative.-24: Forecast: 30–40 in. of rain possible. Bayous and reservoirs projected to overtop.
narrative.-12: Final window for pre-storm actions. Rain bands arriving.

sources: NWS / NOAA: Hurricane Harvey event summary (VERIFY before quoting)
disclaimer: Hazard footprints are approximate and illustrative, not official flood maps. Buildings and dollar figures are synthetic.
